scope: One fixed observed selector trained on actual fitted risk, using frozen v20 and procedural proposals
calibration: Artificial frame zero in the existing corpus only; excluded from motion observations and targets
holdouts: Both development partitions remain exposed. Freeze model before loading either. Six fresh confirmation clips stay absent unless all original old/new/combined gates pass.
label_policy: Only four known poses (or two without context) enter observations; full targets are separate trainer labels
physics_policy: Collapsed semantic edges are not asserted to have constant length; raw baselines do not qualify actual rig physics
next: Evaluate selected compatible predictions on actual-rig editable actions; failed gates forbid promotion
selection: Single prospective596-input,32-hidden,12-choice model; no grid or post-development tuning
reproduction: Regenerate the complete projected training-label cache, features, model fit and old/new/combined development evaluation in a second unique output. Compare all deterministic artifacts and report fields exactly.
runtime: Local NumPy float64, frozen locally cached corpus; no downloads, external APIs, runtime edits, installation or publication
projection_method: Fixed 48-step projected Adam with eight bounded quarter-step backtracking attempts; exact root, terminal orientations and known priorities
fold_group: CMU catalog prefix before underscore, not asserted to be independent actor identity
objective: Cohort-balanced expected projected position+0.1rotation cost, normalized by the best complete procedural control per TRAINING cohort. Exact deployment uses argmax probabilities; expectation/argmax difference is reported.
architecture: One whole-interval choice from4position proposals by3rotation proposals. No per-frame switching or blending of projected poses. Selected v20components include learned residuals; selected procedural components are explicitly procedural.
stationary_acceptance: Zero observed motion selects the existing exact shape/Hermite stationary reference; original stationary and near-stationary tests remain unchanged.
control_policy: Retain original projected linear/Hermite and add projected shape reference. Every ratio and worst-cohort check compares against the best of all three; thresholds remain identical. This prevents procedural improvements from being presented as learned-motion gains.
fold_policy: Same original four parent folds with exact membership and all parent/source hashes. The new selector sees all training labels; no independent selector generalization claim from these folds.
guard_policy: Convex positional blending bounds each predicted coordinate by expert values. This does not guarantee quality versus the best expert. Six fresh confirmation clips stay absent until unchanged development gates pass.
curve_features: At nine fixed normalized query times, summarize each expert versus linear using mean/max positional excursion, speed, acceleration, incoming/outgoing tangent mismatch and semantic-edge length deviation. Normalize by observed per-joint position amplitude or rest semantic-edge length, map zero denominators to zero, apply log1p. Descriptors are not physical guarantees or calibrated uncertainty probabilities.
feature_ownership: Calculate any parent-dependent descriptors with the exact group-excluded parent used for that row. No target or hidden-frame data enters descriptors. No new parent fits or input observations.
rotation_policy: Select complete linear, Hermite or v20rotations; shape rotations are verified equal to Hermite. No quaternion averaging.
projection_label_policy: Each of7358training rows obtains12actual projected costs using exactly the frozen parent excluding its catalog-prefix group. Labels and group/clip IDs never enter inference features.
hypothesis: Prior learners fit raw proposal losses, whereas release metrics evaluate physical projection. Train selection against actual projected outcomes to remove that mismatch; training-only pool and joint-risk oracles pass the original diagnostic gates.
